items.title: Morgan Stanley's digital assets chief on tokenization's future
items.summary: Scott Melker sits down with Morgan Stanley (MS) head of digital asset strategy Amy Oldenburg to discuss the growing role of tokenization in finance and how the firm is building a seamless digital asset experience for its clients. "The Daily Wolf with Scott Melker" airs every day at 12:00 p.m. Tune in for your daily dose of all things crypto. Make sure to also check out Yahoo Finance's new crypto hub to find the latest crypto-related news.

items.title: Pearson (LSE:PSON) Stock Gets Fair Value Bump As Analysts Weigh Execution And Upside
items.summary: Pearson’s fair value estimate has been adjusted from £11.83 to about £12.24, reflecting updated assumptions in recent analyst research. This aligns with commentary that acknowledges Pearson’s progress on execution, while also questioning how much upside remains after the share price move and current guidance. items.title: SpaceX Lockup Expiry: Morgan Stanley Believes ‘Largely Unchanged’ Fundamentals Create Attractive Entry Point At Current Levels
items.summary: Morgan Stanley said that while many investors expect SpaceX shares to fall to $100 as IPO lock-up restrictions expire, such a valuation would imply little or no value for the company’s AI business.
